messages:
Ava Morales: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands: can someone spell out the expected delivery cadence for the API surface work, when Console will match Optimize controls, and what the emergency rollback path looks like for Dedicated customers?
Kenji Nakamura: TL;DR: API v2 pieces will land in 3 phases. Alpha (internal) in ~10 days, Partner canary in ~3 weeks, and GA in ~10-12 weeks if no major regressions. Console parity for Optimize is targeted to reach feature-complete during the Partner canary window.
Priya Desai: To add: "partner canary" means invited customers + internal traffic (~4-6%). Were planning to engage 3 partners with different workloads to validate batching and caching heuristics.
Liam O'Connor: On SDK compatibility: will existing client calls continue to work or do we need a breaking SDK bump?
Kenji Nakamura: Existing endpoints are backward compatible. Well ship a non-breaking client patch that adds v2 features behind opt-in flags. Breaking changes are scheduled only for GA and will have a migration guide.
Zoe Park: For Console + Optimize: which controls are live in beta vs behind flags? I need to tell support which items to advertise.
Priya Desai: Batching presets and basic cache controls -> beta (visible in Console). Advanced quantization suggestions and per-model tuning -> behind feature flags initially, unlocked as partners validate.
Ava Morales: Ops ask: whats the rollback mechanism if the canary shows latency regressions?
Kenji Nakamura: Automated rollback: traffic steering to previous runtime + model variant, flush affected KV caches, and disable batching at runtime for the new runtime. Weve added a manual kill-switch for rollout orchestration too.
release-bot: Pre-release build 2026.03.18-rc4 deployed to staging at 1894501205.
Liam O'Connor: Any telemetry we can preview? I want to add alerts for request tail-latency and cache hit-rate.
Zoe Park: Were publishing a short metric dashboard for the canary: p50/p95/p99 latencies, CPU/GPU util, batch sizes, KV hit-rate. Will share JSON for dashboard import.
Priya Desai: Note on Dedicated: customers with pinned runtime are unaffected unless they opt into the new runtime. For partners who opt in, we provide a pre-checklist (load test, small traffic mirror, SDK smoke tests) and a two-step rollback that does not touch other tenants.
Ava Morales: Can someone prepare a 1-slide exec summary for partner sync and a 2-page migration checklist for customers? I can assemble if you drop bullets here.
Kenji Nakamura: I'll drop bullets + timeline by EOD. Priya will add partner names and test matrix. Zoe will attach dashboard snippet.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks. Please also include the exact flag names well use in SDKs so platform teams can opt-in cleanly.
Priya Desai: Will do. Planning an office hours next Wed 10:00 PT for migration Qs.
Ava Morales: Perfect. Closing thread for now 44d. Post anything else to the release plan doc and the office-hours invite.
